content: Today was a good day. I started off with a refreshing hike at Eno River State Park, which always puts me in a good mood. It was nice to get some fresh air and exercise before heading back to campus. Then, I spent some time playing video games at my apartment, which helped me destress and unwind after a long week of classes and basketball practice. Overall, I feel satisfied with how I spent my day and am looking forward to getting some rest before another busy week.
